title: Dacy's Horse Armor Recipes
description: This data pack adds recipes for all the different *horse armors
body:
This data pack adds 4 different horse armor recipes, one for each type(_except netherite and leather as those already had crafting recipes/smithing recipe_)

However what makes it different from most other data-packs is nugget usage for Iron, Copper, and Gold, as shown here:
